planning.title: Retirement Income Planning
planning.card_text: Turn your savings into a dependable monthly income.
planning.seo_title: Retirement Income Planning in Columbus, OH
planning.h1: Retirement Income Planning in Columbus, Ohio
planning.lead: You don't need a bigger number. You need a paycheck plan.
belief: Most people approach retirement asking, "Have we saved enough?" It's a reasonable question, but it's the wrong one.
The question that matters is, "Where will our paycheck come from every month, for as long as we live?"
familiar: You don't know how much you can withdraw each year
You're unsure when to claim Social Security
You've never seen your retirement income on one page

ideas.title: Your paycheck, not your pile
ideas.text: Start with your monthly needs and the income you can count on. The gap is what your savings must cover.

ideas.title: The three paycheck risks
ideas.text: Market drops early in retirement, living longer than planned, and rising costs can all shrink your income.

ideas.title: Building a paycheck that lasts
ideas.text: Cover essentials with dependable income, make a deliberate Social Security decision, and plan withdrawals for the rest.

planning.how: Step 1 of the Blueprint, your Income Map, puts your whole retirement paycheck on one page.

faq.q: When should I take Social Security?
faq.a: It depends on your health, your spouse, and your other income. We'll look at your options in your Blueprint Session.

planning.title: Estate Planning
planning.card_text: Make sure what you leave goes where you want, without court delays.
planning.seo_title: Estate Planning Help in Columbus, OH
planning.h1: Estate Planning Coordination in Columbus, Ohio
planning.lead: A plan isn't about how much you have. It's about who decides when you can't.
belief: Many families believe a will means everything is handled.
But a will doesn't keep your family out of probate court, and it doesn't cover what happens if you can't make decisions.
familiar: Your will was signed years ago
You're not sure who your beneficiaries are
You have a trust but aren't sure it's set up correctly

ideas.title: A will doesn't keep you out of probate court
ideas.text: Some assets pass by beneficiary designation or title; others go through the court.

ideas.title: Incapacity is the part most people miss
ideas.text: Powers of attorney and health care directives let the right people make decisions.

ideas.title: A plan nobody maintains is a plan that fails
ideas.text: Beneficiaries, titling, and documents need to stay current as life changes.

planning.how: Step 4 of the Blueprint, your Legacy Plan, reviews what you have and coordinates with your estate attorney.
planning.note: We are not attorneys and do not provide legal advice. Legal documents are prepared by a licensed attorney.

faq.q: Do you write wills and trusts?
faq.a: No. We coordinate with licensed estate planning attorneys, who prepare all legal documents.
